 Is the Kalshi Promo Code SBWIRE55 Available in Your State?
 Kalshi works under CFTC oversight as a designated contract market. Federal regulation lets it operate in places where sports betting has not launched. As of October 2026, the Kalshi promo code works in 39 states plus Washington, D.C.
 It is not offered in Arizona, Illinois, Massachusetts, Maryland, Michigan, Minnesota, Montana, Nevada, New Jersey, Ohio or Washington. Courts are still weighing challenges to sports contracts, so the list may change.
 How to Use the Kalshi Promo Code SBWIRE55
 Tap any PLAY NOW link to go to Kalshi.
 Set up a new account with your name, address, date of birth and the verification details required.

 New accounts only. The reward usually posts about 24 hours after you meet the requirement.
 Why Kalshi Is Different From a Sportsbook
 Kalshi is a marketplace, not a bookmaker. You buy and sell contracts with other traders. Each contract is priced from $0 to $1, and that price shows how likely the crowd thinks something is to happen. If you are right, the contract settles at $1. If you are wrong, it settles at $0.
 With no operator-set line, you can sell before the event finishes, either to lock in a profit or to cut a loss.
 An Example of a Kalshi Trade
 Say a contract sells for $0.60, a 60% implied chance. Ten shares cost $6. A correct outcome pays $10, which is a $4 profit, and a wrong one pays nothing. The same contract can cost more or less later in the day as news arrives.
 Using the Kalshi Promo Code SBWIRE55 on the NFL Season

 Week 5 is just one stop. The regular season runs 18 weeks, followed by the playoffs and Super Bowl LXI, so the Kalshi promo code SBWIRE55 gets you in early for the whole year.
 Kalshi Promo Code SBWIRE55 FAQs
 What Is the Kalshi Promo Code?

 How Do I Claim the Kalshi Bonus?

 How Does Kalshi Work?
 Contracts ask yes-or-no questions about real events, cost between $0 and $1 and settle at $1 if correct.
 Where Can I Use Kalshi?
